mission_08: Outstanding! You have built a reproducible experiment framework that brings scientific rigor to machine learning development. By controlling random seeds across all components, using stratified cross-validation with fixed splits, and recording complete metadata for each experiment, your framework ensures that every result can be exactly reproduced. The structured results format captures not just accuracy scores but also timing, pipeline configuration, and timestamps, providing a complete audit trail. This approach is essential for research publications, regulatory compliance, and any scenario where ML decisions must be justified and verified. The experiment runner pattern scales from individual data scientist workflows to team-wide ML experiment tracking systems, forming the foundation of reproducible ML practice.
